_meta.purpose: Official social-media accounts of Telangana leaders, parties and government bodies. Merged into politicalData.js / politicalEntities.js so the sentiment pipeline recognises a leader when a post names the handle AND when the leader/party is the AUTHOR.
_meta.researched: 2026-09-30. Every X handle below was fetched live from api.fxtwitter.com (public profile JSON) and its bio read before being recorded here. Follower counts are from that same fetch.
_meta.status: CONFIRMED = the account's own bio states the office or party role, or an official site links it. LIKELY = strong circumstantial match not confirmed from the account itself. Nothing is listed on inference alone.
deliberately_absent: N. Ramchander Rao (BJP Telangana state president) — no official account found. @NRamchanderRao exists but has 2 followers and the bio 'sining'; it is not him and encoding it would mis-attribute every post from that account.
Bomma Mahesh Kumar Goud (TPCC president) — only 3-follower namesakes found.
J. Santosh Kumar (BRS general secretary) — @JSanthoshKumar is a different person (Santhosh Janakiraman).
Telangana Rakshana Sena party account — the party is months old and no official handle was found. K. Kavitha's personal account is listed under people.
All YouTube channel IDs — not verified for any party or leader here.
_meta.note_trs_collision: @trspartyonline is the BRS-era handle. Its live bio reads '@trspartyonline handle is now archived.. Please follow @brsparty for official updates'. It is recorded as ARCHIVED, not as a live BRS account, and must not be confused with K. Kavitha's Telangana Rakshana Sena, which also abbreviates to TRS.
_meta.keys: people = leader id in config/politicalData.js, or 'ac:<constituencykey>' for a seat-derived MLA. parties = party id. government = institutional accounts.
